uzo.purpose: Lets a person choose one or more files to send with a form, and states which files are allowed.

instead.kialo: A value a person types is text, because nothing is chosen from the device; the kampo takes it.

boundary.kialo: Sending the files and showing how far they got belongs to the application, because the field only chooses and checks them (E7); a person decides how the upload reports progress, failure and retry.
A picture of a chosen image is content of its own, because it needs a text alternative and room the list of files does not have; a person decides whether and where it shows.
Taking a photo is a device of its own, because the camera opens outside the form and asks for a permission; the field chooses files that exist.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A file input without a form has no sender, because the files are only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may ask for a file before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need one (an attachment to a reason).

with.kialo: A file input stands among the fields of a form, because it is one of them whose value is files; it stacks with them.
The button that chooses is a butono with emphasis medium and every remove a butono with emphasis low, because they are the system's actions; the form ends with the button that sends it.
The button that chooses shows the icon upload, every remove the icon close, because the sign is read faster than the word; the words name the action.

never.kialo: A file input stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the input could not be reached on its own.

case.de: Der Wert wird getippt, etwa ein Name oder eine Adresse, und liegt nicht als Datei auf dem Gerät.
case.en: The value is typed, such as a name or an address, and is not a file on the device.

case.de: Eine Datei soll nur übergeben werden, die Person lädt sie herunter statt hoch.
case.en: A file is only handed over: the person downloads it instead of uploading one.

do.de: Nenne in der Hilfe vorab, welche Dateiarten, welche Größe und wie viele Dateien erlaubt sind.
do.en: State in the help, before anyone chooses, which kinds of file, which size and how many files are allowed.

do.de: Setze multiple, wenn mehrere Dateien zusammengehören; jede gewählte Datei lässt sich einzeln wieder entfernen.
do.en: Set multiple when several files belong together; every chosen file can be removed on its own.

do.de: Biete die Ablagefläche nur zusätzlich an, denn die Schaltfläche allein muss alles können.
do.en: Offer the drop area only as an extra, because the button alone has to do everything.

dont.de: Die erlaubten Dateien erst in der Fehlermeldung verraten.
dont.en: Reveal the allowed files only in the error message.

dont.de: Eine Höchstzahl an Dateien ohne multiple setzen: Eine einzelne Datei ist nie zu viele.
dont.en: Set a most number of files without multiple: a single file is never too many.

dont.de: Den Fortschritt des Hochladens im Feld zeigen, denn Senden und Fortschritt gehören der Anwendung.
dont.en: Show the progress of the upload in the field, because sending and progress belong to the application.

action.de: Öffnet die Dateiauswahl des Geräts; auf dem Knopf neben einer gewählten Datei nimmt die Taste diese Datei aus der Liste.
action.en: Opens the file chooser of the device; on the button next to a chosen file the key takes that file out of the list.
